api_key.description: The API Key used to authenticate to defectdojo

base_url.description: Base URL of the defectdojo installation

password.description: The password used to authenticate to defectdojo. Has no effect if api_key is set.

username.description: The username used to authenticate to defectdojo. Has no effect if api_key is set.

enable_engagement_epic_mapping.description: Whether to map engagements to epics in Jira

engagement_id.description: The ID of the Engagement. Although optional, either the Product ID or the Engagement ID must be defined to create a Jira Product Configuration.

issue_template_dir.description: The folder containing Django templates used to render the JIRA issue description. Leave empty to use the default jira_full templates.

jira_instance_id.description: The ID of the Jira Instance to use for this Product

product_id.description: The ID of the Product to configure. Although optional, either the Product ID or the Engagement ID must be defined to create a Jira Product Configuration.

push_all_issues.description: Automatically maintain parity with JIRA. Always create and update JIRA tickets for findings in this Product.

push_notes.description: Whether to push notes to Jira

risk_acceptance_expiration_notification.description: Send Risk Acceptance expiration notifications as comments

block.description: A Jira Product Configuration is the connection between a Product and a Jira Instance. It defines the Product's settings for pushing Findings to Jira.

business_criticality.description: The Business Criticality of the Product. Valid values are: 'very high', 'high', 'medium', 'low', 'very low', 'none'

enable_full_risk_acceptance.description: Allows full risk acceptance using a risk acceptance form, expiration date, uploaded proof, etc.

enable_skip_risk_acceptance.description: Allows simple risk acceptance by checking/unchecking a checkbox.

external_audience.description: Specify if the application is used by people outside the organization.

internet_accessible.description: Specify if the application is accessible from the public internet.

life_cycle.description: The Lifecycle state of the Product. Valid values are: 'construction', 'production', 'retirement'

origin.description: The Origin of the Product. Valid values are: 'third party library', 'purchased', 'contractor', 'internal', 'open source', 'outsourced'

platform.description: The Platform of the Product. Valid values are: 'web service', 'desktop', 'iot', 'mobile', 'web'

prod_numeric_grade.description: The Numeric Grade of the Product

product_manager_id.description: The ID of the user who is the PM for this product.

product_type_id.description: The ID of the Product Type

regulation_ids.description: The IDs of the Regulations which apply to this product.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the product

team_manager_id.description: The ID of the user who is the manager for this product.

technical_contact_id.description: The ID of the user who is the technical contact for this product.

user_records.description: Estimate the number of user records within the application.
